name: Adam
summary: Adam (IG handle @unlike) is an operator/agency owner who came in through DMs and runs a team managing many social accounts, including OF-adjacent creator pages (e.g. 'celeste' link.boo funnels) — but as a buyer of account-recovery services, not a management client. He paid (via Trevor) to get a banned/restricted Facebook page appealed and restored, then to have a shadowban removed on that page, and received compliance advice (remove OF link from bio/about, stop cross-posting, tone down suggestive captions). He's since been probing pricing on TikTok unbans ($4,500 each, needs username/email/ban-reason screenshot, no login required), an @ad Instagram username claim ($20-30k budget, told it's unstable/cybered and not viable), and X/Twitter unbans for gambling accounts (@duel, @monarch, @csgoempire — quoted ~$100k for all three with warranty, must go through a specific third-party middleman). Warm, high-volume repeat prospect with real budget who says he has more high-profile cases coming — worth following up on the FanDuel/gambling X case and giving him a general service menu.
